## 🎮 Nintendo Switch / Switch OLED Travel Case

Looking for a **robust and stylish case** to take your Nintendo Switch everywhere? This 3D-printed box is designed to **fit both the original Switch and the OLED version** with the Joy-Cons attached, making it the perfect travel companion.

✨ **Features**

- 🛡️ Strong and durable design – perfect for travel
- 🎮 Fits the **original Nintendo Switch & Switch OLED** (Joy-Cons attached)
- 🎨 Multiple cover designs available: Switch logo, Zelda, Pikachu, 1UP Mushroom, and Sheikah Slate (more to come!)
- 💾 Storage for **24 game cartridges** inside the lid
- 🔗 2 slots for Joy-Con straps (slide them in for secure fit)
- 🔒 Small insert to hold the Switch firmly in place (separate piece, replaceable or printable in PETG for extra strength)

🛠️ **Printing & Assembly**

- Prints easily in **PLA** (avoid Silk PLA, as weaker layer adhesion may cause issues with screws)
- Requires **6× M3×40 screws** (insert from outside to inside)
- Modular insert piece can be replaced if worn out

💡 **Background**

After releasing my case for the **Switch 2**, many of you asked for a version compatible with the **original Switch & OLED** – so here it is! Thanks to everyone who suggested it 🙌
